app.name: DebtMap
app.tagline: Find the risk hiding in your codebase

home.heading: Which files in your repository are actually dangerous?
home.subheading: Paste a public GitHub repository. DebtMap ranks its files by security exposure and bug-proneness, and explains why.
home.invalidUrl: Enter a public GitHub repository URL, for example https://github.com/owner/name

results.heading: Risk map
results.truncated: Showing the {{analysed}} largest of {{discovered}} files found.
results.noFiles: No TypeScript or JavaScript files were found in this repository.

file.heading: File detail
file.noFindings: No security findings in this file.
file.noExplanation: No explanation was generated for this file.

scan.heading: Scanner status
scan.notRun: This check did not run, so its findings are unknown — not absent.

repoFindings.heading: Repository-level findings
repoFindings.explanation: These belong to the repository rather than to any one file: vulnerable dependencies, and secrets committed to paths outside the analysed source set — including files that were deleted but remain in history.

trend.heading: Trend
trend.needsTwoRuns: Run the analysis again to see a trend.

error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

apiError.invalidUrl: Enter a public GitHub repository URL, for example https://github.com/owner/name
apiError.repoNotFound: {{repo}} was not found. It must exist and be public.
apiError.repoPrivate: Private repositories are not supported yet.
apiError.repoTooLarge: {{repo}} is {{sizeMb}} MB, over the {{limitMb}} MB limit.
apiError.githubRateLimit: GitHub's request limit has been reached. Please try again in a while.
apiError.dailyLimit: The daily limit of {{limit}} analyses has been reached. Please try again tomorrow.
apiError.analysisNotFound: That analysis could not be found.
apiError.fileNotFound: That file is not part of this analysis.

runError.noSourceFiles: No TypeScript or JavaScript files were found in this repository.
runError.cloneFailed: The repository could not be downloaded.
runError.interrupted: The analysis was interrupted by a server restart. Please run it again.

runError.queueFailed: The analysis could not be started. Please try again.
runError.unknown: The analysis failed because of an unexpected error.
